topic: E-commerce boosts Home Depot, Lowe’s in Q3
body: Home Depot and Lowe's are riding the e-commerce wave, as their digital sales surged in Q3. But the real game-changer isn't just in getting more customers online, it's in keeping them coming back. Retention marketing is where Purands AI steps in. Our AI agents sit on top of a retailer's CRM and messaging channels, like WhatsApp and Shopify, to manage customer engagement effectively. We focus on tasks like win-back campaigns, replenishment reminders, and abandoned-cart recovery. These are not just buzzwords; they are concrete workflows that drive repeat purchases and boost customer lifetime value (LTV). Why does it work? Because our AI analyzes customer data to predict churn and identify opportunities for personalization. This means more relevant interactions that keep customers loyal, even in a competitive e-commerce landscape. For giants like Home Depot and Lowe's, integrating a strategy like ours could turn their e-commerce growth into sustained profitability, rather than a temporary spike.
